baseline_models.mechanism: The address works through two complementary anticipations: good news opens hope, warning awakens caution, and hearing completes either signal as understanding and responsive acceptance. Turning away interrupts both channels.

activation_trace.role: News that opens the face with joy supplies the attractive pole of the address.
A warning that wakes caution supplies the aversive pole of the same address.
Turning one's side away supplies the bodily refusal that blocks both poles.
Hearing as understanding and compliance makes the failure responsive rather than merely acoustic.

changed_reading.before: A bearer gives good news and warning, but most people do not listen.
changed_reading.after: A two-pole address seeks hopeful or cautious response; the majority's turn is refusal to understand and answer either mode, not simple failure to detect sound.

baseline_models.mechanism: The root of turning also carries presentation and side-orientation. The focus can therefore stage communication as an offered interface that fails when receivers present only their side rather than a receptive front.

activation_trace.role: Presenting something for attention supplies the offered side of the communicative interface.
Turning the side supplies the receiver's contrary orientation.
Auditory reception marks the interface whose alignment has failed.

changed_reading.before: The message is offered and then ignored.
changed_reading.after: The disclosed address meets a receiver who rotates out of receptive alignment; non-hearing is the result of relational orientation.

baseline_models.mechanism: The majority is both a count and a possible dominance by number. Public circulation of a message can coexist with a mass field in which genuine reception is socially crowded out.

activation_trace.role: Numerical competition and dominance make the majority a possible social force rather than a neutral statistic.
Public circulation or repute distinguishes widespread audibility from receptive hearing.

changed_reading.before: Many separate individuals happen not to listen.
changed_reading.after: A numerical majority may set a public field in which the message circulates while collective receptivity is suppressed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus non-hearing is bracketed by detailed, lucid Arabic and a later counterfactual objection to non-Arabic speech. Ear-weight and the image of a call from far away relocate the problem from insufficient encoding to receiver-produced distance.

activation_trace.role: Detailing that exposes parts and meanings supplies articulated message structure immediately before the focus.
Lucid expression supplies intelligibility rather than obscurity.
The opposite of clear, understood sound supplies the hypothetical alternative that also attracts objection.
The ear's branch of attending and accepting identifies the reception being withheld.
Weight in the ear supplies a receiver-side impediment.
The range and remoteness of a raised call turns intelligibility into perceived distance.
Distance from nearness fixes the spatial image of failed reception.

structural_cues: 41:3 immediately precedes the focus with detailed Arabic, while 41:44 revisits language, ear-weight, blindness, and a distant call in one sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies clarity, the foreign-language counterfactual, ear-weight, and distance; I infer that distance is being made at reception rather than residing in the message. A live alternative is genuine linguistic incomprehension represented figuratively.

changed_reading.before: They do not hear because the communication does not reach them effectively.
changed_reading.after: The communication is differentiated and intelligible, yet receivers convert nearness into a distant call through withheld attention and weighted ears.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah expands non-hearing into a layered enclosure: protected coverings around inner reception, load in the ears, and a barrier across the space between speaker and hearer. The speakers themselves name the blockade.

activation_trace.role: Understanding and responsive acceptance define what the enclosure prevents.
Protective concealment supplies the innermost layer around reception.
Attending and accepting what is heard identifies the ear-level function being denied.
Weight in the ear supplies the middle layer that impedes reception.
Prevention of access supplies the outer interpersonal barrier.

structural_cues: 41:5 directly follows 41:4 and moves from heart, to ear, to the space between the two parties.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies coverings, ear-weight, and a barrier in that order; I read them as nested reception defenses maintained by the speakers. A live alternative is a static figurative incapacity rather than an engineered enclosure.

changed_reading.before: Non-hearing is a single failed faculty.
changed_reading.after: Non-hearing is a self-described, multi-layer defense spanning inward understanding, sensory admission, and social access.

context_deltas.mechanism: The heraldic بَشِير is followed by بَشَرٌ مِثْلُكُمْ who receives revelation. The role is thus embodied in an ordinary human interface: hidden knowledge arrives through revelation and is exposed through a peer rather than an inaccessible kind of being.

activation_trace.role: The visible-skinned human supplies the embodied bearer immediately after the heraldic use of the same root.
Likeness and peerhood make the bearer continuous with the audience.
News or inspiration from God supplies the hidden input that the human bearer makes public.

structural_cues: 41:6 follows the rejection scene and places بَشَرٌ مِثْلُكُمْ directly beside passive reception of revelation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent same-root forms, human likeness, and revelation; I infer an interface from hidden receipt to public heralding. A live alternative is that the same-root proximity is lexical coincidence without functional force.

changed_reading.before: The bearer is only a role attached to the message.
changed_reading.after: The bearer is a deliberately ordinary human contact surface through which concealed revelation becomes shareable good news and warning.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus order recurs as turning away followed by explicit warning, then another scene says guidance was supplied but blindness was preferred. Non-hearing becomes an elected orientation under adequate guidance, and warning becomes the consequence keyed to that repeated turn.

activation_trace.role: The repeated act of turning the side preserves the focus refusal as the condition of the warning.
Warning that wakes caution becomes an explicit response to the repeated turn.
Gentle indication toward a path establishes that orientation was available.
Heart-attached preference supplies volition rather than accidental sensory failure.
Blindness as chosen intention supplies the selected contrary orientation.

structural_cues: 41:13 repeats the focus roots ع ر ض then ن ذ ر in the same causal sequence; 41:17 explicitly contrasts supplied guidance with preferred blindness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recurrence, guidance, preference, and chosen blindness; I connect selected orientation to non-hearing and the ensuing warning. A live alternative is that the later historical scenes illustrate consequences without defining the focus audience's agency.

changed_reading.before: Most fail to listen and therefore happen to remain warned.
changed_reading.after: Most select a turned orientation despite available guidance; warning is the answering speech act to that deliberate non-reception.

context_deltas.mechanism: The hearing denied at the focus later stands as a witness alongside bodily surfaces, which are then made to speak. This separates acoustic registration from accepted understanding: refused reception does not keep the sensory interface from becoming evidence.

activation_trace.role: Hearing as understanding and compliance marks the responsive sense in which the focus says they do not hear.
The auditory faculty itself supplies the later evidentiary witness.
Testimony as informed declaration converts sensation into disclosed evidence.
The body's skin extends witness from the ear to the embodied surface.
Speech gives the previously silent bodily witness an explicit voice.

structural_cues: 41:20 names hearing, sight, and skins as witnesses; 41:21 immediately asks the skins why they testified and answers through their speech.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies later sensory testimony and speaking skin; I infer a distinction between registered input and refused understanding. A live alternative is that the witness is newly enabled rather than preserving any prior sensory record.

changed_reading.before: They receive no meaningful auditory input.
changed_reading.after: They refuse hearing as understanding, yet the sensory faculty remains answerable and can reverse from rejected receiver into witness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The majority's non-hearing becomes an organized tactic: a collective imperative forbids receptive hearing, mixed noise occupies the channel, and domination is the stated aim. Attention is contested socially rather than merely absent individually.

activation_trace.role: Dominance by number supplies the latent social force in the focus majority.
The command not to hear targets understanding and acceptance, not sound detection alone.
Mixed vocal noise supplies the interference used to occupy the auditory channel.
Coercive prevailing supplies the social purpose of manufactured non-hearing.

structural_cues: 41:26 joins an imperative not to hear, an imperative to make noise, and a purpose clause of prevailing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet explicitly supplies command, interference, and intended dominance; I read them as a causal attention-control strategy. A live alternative is narrower victory in argument rather than control of the public listening field.

changed_reading.before: The majority passively fails to listen.
changed_reading.after: A majority culture actively produces non-hearing by filling the channel with noise so receptive attention cannot form and opponents can prevail.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus role of good-news bearer is later performed as an imperative that removes anticipated fear and present grief, opens a promised garden, and ends in prepared hospitality. Good news is an arrival that reorients affect and future residence.

activation_trace.role: The imperative to receive joy performs the focus heraldic role rather than merely naming it.
Expected harm supplies the future-facing affect that the good news cancels.
The roughness of grief supplies the present affect that the announcement smooths.
A promise that opens hope gives the announcement its future object.
Prepared lodging for an arriving guest turns promise into hospitable reception.

structural_cues: 41:30 repeats the focus good-news root in an imperative framed by no fear and no grief; 41:32 closes the sequence with guest-provision.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies performed good news, affective negation, promise, and hospitality; I connect them as the concrete operation of the focus noun. A live alternative is that the later announcement is only another use of the root, not an exposition of 41:4.

changed_reading.before: Good news is a generic positive half of the message.
changed_reading.after: Good news is an enacted transition from fear and grief into promised, prepared welcome for those who remain straight rather than turn away.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same root later marks turning away under blessing and a broad prayer under harm, while side-distance makes the first posture explicit. The focus turn becomes an asymmetric aperture: constricted toward incoming address, expansive toward outgoing demand when distress touches the self.

activation_trace.role: Good condition supplies the setting in which the receiver closes toward incoming address.
Turning the side supplies the closed, distancing use of the repeated focus root.
Breadth supplies the contrasting expansion of the person's own prayer.
Taking one's side far away makes the bodily geometry of turning explicit.
The bodily side identifies the surface deliberately presented to the address.
The impact of harm supplies the contact that reverses closure into expansive demand.
Calling by speech supplies the outward channel that becomes broad when self-interest requires it.

structural_cues: 41:51 places أَعْرَضَ, نَأَى بِجَانِبِهِ, and دُعَاءٍ عَرِيضٍ in one conditional contrast between ease and touched harm.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies same-root closure and breadth, explicit side-distance, touch, and prayer; I infer a one-way communicative aperture. A live alternative is ordinary contrast between ingratitude and desperation without deliberate spatial wordplay.

changed_reading.before: Turning away is a stable refusal to communicate.
changed_reading.after: Turning away is selective channel control: the receiver narrows incoming good news and warning yet broadens outgoing appeal when harm reaches him.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the skin/surface branch of ب ش ر rather than only the conventional good-news branch. It remains anchored in بَشِيرًا and gains packet support when skins later testify and speak, but downstream prose should present it as an embodied surface analogy, not claim that the text etymologically equates glad tidings with stored skin testimony.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: بَشِيرًا and the failed sensory reception of لَا يَسْمَعُونَ

activation_trace.role: Visible skin and surface supply an exploratory embodied register within the focus herald word.
The bodily skin supplies a later literal surface that participates in testimony.
Informed declaration turns the embodied surface into disclosed evidence.
Speech gives the surface a voice and completes the cross-domain activation.

changed_reading.before: The good-news bearer addresses an audience through abstract verbal content.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the herald addresses embodied surfaces that can brighten, turn away, register action, and finally become speaking witnesses.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because 41:11 has no hearing root and applies willing response to sky and earth. It remains anchored through the focus branch of hearing as understanding and obedience and through a spoken summons answered willingly, but downstream prose should call it a structural analogy rather than a lexical gloss of يَسْمَعُونَ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: لَا يَسْمَعُونَ through the understanding-and-obedience branch of س م ع

activation_trace.role: Hearing as understanding and compliance anchors the analogy in the focus.
Coming in answer to address supplies enacted response rather than acoustic description.
Willing obedience supplies the cosmic counterpart to the human majority's non-hearing.

changed_reading.before: Human non-hearing is only a defect within the audience.
changed_reading.after: As a contained structural analogy, the human majority refuses the responsive hearing that even the addressed cosmos enacts willingly.

strongest_changes: Non-hearing becomes a layered, self-described barricade rather than a single sensory failure.
41:26 exposes collective non-hearing as manufactured noise aimed at social dominance.
The denied faculty later becomes a witness, separating acoustic registration from accepted understanding.
Good news and warning are both enacted later: welcome cancels fear and grief, while warning answers a repeated chosen turn.
41:51 recasts turning away as a selective aperture that closes to incoming address and widens for self-serving prayer.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah recurrence repeatedly moved the failure from message quality to receiver posture: clear articulation becomes perceived distance, the ordinary human herald is rejected, attention is actively jammed, sensory faculties reverse into witnesses, and the ع ر ض root finally exposes an asymmetry between turning away and broad demand.
remaining_uncertainties: The ب ش ر surface-to-speaking-skin activation is branch-valid but may be associative rather than intended wordplay.
The willing response of sky and earth may illuminate hearing-as-obedience only analogically.
The closure-versus-breadth reading of 41:51 may be deliberate root-play or simply a strong reader-supplied spatial synthesis.
